name: design-os-knowledge-builder
description: Deterministic multimodal knowledge compiler with `UKMC.v1` schema enforcement, SHA-256 provenance, and a 6-validator epistemic gate.

interface.shortDescription: Deterministic multimodal knowledge compiler with `UKMC.v1` schema enforcement, SHA-256 provenance, and a 6-validator epistemic gate.
interface.longDescription: Compile web documentation, PDFs, codebases, and videos into hallucination-free, token-budgeted knowledge packs (`SKILL.md` + `knowledge/**/*.md`) ready for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Antigravity.
defaultPrompt: Compile these technical RFCs into a UKMC.v1 knowledge pack with SHA-256 source attribution and failure-mode checklists.
Audit our knowledge/ directory with the 6-validator epistemic gate and fix any missing frontmatter or untrusted quarantine flags.
Generate a progressive-disclosure SKILL.md router and llms.txt index for our domain knowledge base.
